name: Levin
source:
"Ah, um... I'm Levin. Right now... I'm the temporary manager of the Night Owl café. Haaah... how did it come to this? Well... I don't necessary hate it..."

Currently employed as the temporary manager of the Night Owl café by its owner, [url=/c160718]Hajime[/url]. A strange Luden who dislikes scary stories, but ironically knows a lot about them. He's strikingly handsome, which supposedly draws many regular female customers.

He sometimes lashes out angrily to hide his fears. Apparently, his fans enjoy that, too? I don't quite get it...

While tired of the madness consuming the world, he fulfills his role as manager and keeps a certain secret entrusted to him by Alice. He sells a variety of goods to adventurers as well. [url=/c160572]Sayaka[/url] can stock up on supplies with him.

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category2&ch=levin]official website[/url]]
